noticias.titulo: COFEPRIS registers GO-PEN reusable insulin pen; Mexico is its first market
noticias.resumen: Danish company GO-Pen ApS received a COFEPRIS sanitary registration for GO-PEN, a reusable pen for people using vial insulin. Mexico is the first commercial launch market and Grupo LYBB will be the exclusive importer and distributor. The device already has FDA 510(k) clearance and a CE mark (class IIb).
noticias.accion: Context: new competition in insulin delivery devices for pharmacies and diabetes clinics.

noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS warned about counterfeit units of KitoCream (pirfenidone 10%), a product it classifies as a medical device, sold online. The fakes have no lot number or expiry date, a dark brown color and no secondary packaging. The alert follows a report by the registration holder, Grupo Medifarma.
noticias.accion: If you sell or stock KitoCream, verify lot and expiry on every unit and buy only from the registration holder or its authorized distributors.

noticias.titulo: How COFEPRIS classifies and reviews AI and software as a medical device
noticias.resumen: Software and AI tools are regulated under the same Class I-III risk system as physical devices. Applicants must show clinical association, analytical and clinical validation, change control for model updates and cybersecurity. Devices already approved by trusted foreign regulators can use an abbreviated pathway with a 30-business-day target. Specific AI rules are still being drafted.
noticias.accion: If you plan to register a software or AI product in Mexico, prepare clinical validation and change-control documentation now and check eligibility for the abbreviated pathway.

noticias.titulo: Third 2027-2028 tender closes; a fourth will cover the remaining 10%
noticias.resumen: The Ministry of Health and Birmex say nearly 90% of the keys needed for 2027-2028 are now covered. The third tender awarded 673 keys (997.6 million pieces, MXN 34.4 billion), including wound-care, laboratory and radiology supplies; Mexican suppliers won 57% of pieces. A fourth tender is planned before year-end.
noticias.accion: If you lost keys or did not bid, prepare for the fourth tender; winners must sign contracts within 20 days of the award.

noticias.titulo: COFEPRIS joins #MedSafetyWeek to boost adverse-event reporting
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS is taking part in the global #MedSafetyWeek campaign (November 2-8, 2026) to increase reports of suspected adverse effects of medicines and vaccines through VigiRam and VigiVac.
noticias.accion: Context: expect more attention on pharmacovigilance and technovigilance reporting; review that your internal reporting process is up to date.

noticias.titulo: Government plans purchase of about 6 billion supply pieces for IMSS-Bienestar
noticias.resumen: The federal government announced the purchase of roughly 6 billion pieces of medicines and supplies for IMSS-Bienestar hospitals, from oncology drugs to wound-care material. It will prioritize direct purchases from manufacturers and reverse auctions, and favor suppliers that meet quality and delivery terms. Details are published at compraconsolidada.salud.gob.mx.
noticias.accion: Track awards and delivery performance on compraconsolidada.salud.gob.mx; on-time delivery will weigh in future awards.

noticias.titulo: COFEPRIS aims to clear 70% of its backlog by December; devices lag behind
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS expects to resolve more than 70% of pending medicine and device applications by December 2026. Responses to device requests rose only 8%, due to a shortage of specialized staff; it hired 70 people, mainly for devices and clinical trials. It also plans broader rules for AI-based devices and a single digital window by 2027.
noticias.accion: If you have device registrations pending, expect delays and keep your dossiers complete to avoid deficiency letters.

noticias.titulo: Counterfeit lots of Riopan, IMMUNORHO and Granulox wound spray
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS issued alerts for counterfeit or altered lots of Riopan gel (lots 12542237 and 12191278), IMMUNORHO 300 µg anti-D immunoglobulin (lot 09b84695, not recognized by Kedrion) and Granulox wound spray (lot 16115143, expiry altered from 2019 to 2026). The alerts apply only to the listed lots.
noticias.accion: Check inventory for these lots, do not dispense them and buy only from suppliers authorized by the registration holder.

noticias.titulo: Counterfeit Synvisc Hylan G-F20 in circulation (lot ARSP005)
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS issued a risk alert for counterfeit Synvisc Hylan G-F20, an intra-articular medical device registered by Sanofi Mexico. Fake units of lot ARSP005 show a February 2026 expiry, while the genuine lot expired in February 2023.
noticias.accion: Check your inventory for lot ARSP005, buy only from distributors authorized by the registration holder and require proof of legal acquisition.

noticias.titulo: New guidelines for the safe use of medicines and health supplies
noticias.resumen: The Ministry of Health published technical guidelines on the safe use of medicines and health supplies for the National Health System. They are guidance documents and do not by themselves create new obligations or change existing rules.
noticias.accion: Context: hospital clients may update their internal safe-use protocols; no immediate action required.

noticias.titulo: 94.5% of 2027-2028 medical supplies awarded; the rest will be re-tendered
noticias.resumen: The federal government awarded 94.5% of the planned volume of medical and wound-care supplies (group 060) for IMSS, IMSS-Bienestar and ISSSTE for 2027-2028: 646 million pieces worth MXN 12.57 billion across 239 codes, with 135 companies taking part. The remaining 5.5% will go through new procurement before the end of 2026, and awarded contracts must be signed within 20 days.
noticias.accion: If you supply group 060 items and lost codes, watch for the new tenders before year-end; if you won, prepare contract paperwork within the 20-day window.

noticias.titulo: Alerts on illegally sold Sculptra and counterfeit meropenem
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS warned about Sculptra (poly-L-lactic acid, lot A00203) sold illegally online, a counterfeit lot of meropenem 1 g (lot X2MF160A) not imported by the authorized distributor, and a voluntary recall of Sortec 200 mg lot 5CE003A.
noticias.accion: Aesthetic clinics and hospitals should verify the origin of these products and buy only through recognized suppliers.

noticias.titulo: Public viewer for medical device registrations
noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS launched a public online viewer to check whether a medical device holds a valid sanitary registration. Registration holders can submit observations on the published information.
noticias.accion: Check that your registrations appear correctly in the viewer and report any error, since buyers now use it to verify products.

noticias.resumen: COFEPRIS published its 2026-I bulletin on the surveillance of medicines, vaccines and medical devices, including a chapter on the risk analysis of medical devices. It stresses that more reports about a device do not automatically mean higher risk.
noticias.accion: Context: useful reference for how COFEPRIS interprets device incident reports.
